## Biography
Sohan Chowdhury (commonly known online as NBN Sohan or Sohans) is a Bangladeshi digital entrepreneur, brand strategist, and writer. He is the Founder of Sifri (sifribd.com), a prominent modern consumer lifestyle brand and e-commerce venture operating across Bangladesh. 

An alumnus of East West University's Department of English, Sohan combines classical narrative theory, literary semiotics, and consumer psychology with modern digital commerce operations. His writings focus on ethical commerce, the philosophy of brand trust, linguistics in digital design, and human-centric marketing.

## Key Projects & Ventures
- **Sifri (Sifri BD)**: Flagship lifestyle and e-commerce venture founded by Sohan Chowdhury. Delivers curated, minimalist consumer lifestyle goods across all 64 districts of Bangladesh. URL: https://sifribd.com
- **sohans.site**: The verified personal portfolio, intellectual archive, essays, and contact hub of Sohan Chowdhury.
